correctness.rationale: The verifier reconstructs f=(16,115,198,99). After contracting a spanning tree, unimodular reduction of the 198 facial relations gives Smith invariants 1^97,2 with two free columns, hence H1=Z^2+Z/2. Two integral cocycles give a surjective free coordinate map and a third mod-two cocycle detects a cycle in its unique order-two kernel. Exhaustion of all 495 graph triangles finds 198 faces and 297 nonfacial cycles, none null-homologous, with the exact seven-class multiplicities 55,54,41,40,38,36,33.

value.rationale: For H1=Z^2+Z/2, the shortest simple-cycle layer naturally mixes free directions and torsion decorations. The complete result is structurally sharp: every empty triangle is essential, the pure torsion class alone has 55 shortest representatives, and the remaining 242 systoles realize both torsion lifts of exactly three primitive free directions. This is a compact combinatorial analogue of a shortest-vector shell with torsion data, not a recomputation of the ambient homology group.
